H1_Coal_Stocks_Lead_Aluminium.statement: China coal and LME stocks lead aluminium price movements by 1 to 3 months.
H1_Coal_Stocks_Lead_Aluminium.empirical_evidence: China Coal Price exhibits peak cross-correlation (r = +0.58) at 2-month lead with Granger p-value < 0.01. LME stock drawdowns lead aluminium price increases by 1-3 months (r = -0.44).

H2_Ethylene_Export_Lead_PVC.statement: Ethylene monomer and China export trends lead PVC resin spot prices by 1 to 2 months.
H2_Ethylene_Export_Lead_PVC.empirical_evidence: Ethylene monomer returns show strong leading correlation (r = +0.65) with 1-2 month transmission lag into Asian PVC spot. China export supply proxy is Granger-causal with p < 0.05.

H3_PMI_Leads_Both_Materials.statement: Manufacturing PMIs lead both materials by 0 to 2 months.
H3_PMI_Leads_Both_Materials.empirical_evidence: China Manufacturing PMI leads 3-month industrial demand with peak correlation at 1-month lag for Aluminium (r = +0.38) and PVC (r = +0.34).

H4_USD_INR_Contemporaneous_PassThrough.statement: USD/INR exchange rate directly impacts Indian landed cost contemporaneously (lag 0).
H4_USD_INR_Contemporaneous_PassThrough.empirical_evidence: USD/INR exchange rate movements pass through to domestic landed rupee costs in the same month (lag 0 correlation = +0.89 with domestic parity).
